profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer - Wizards of the Coast
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer specializing in emulation, game porting, and game engine performance optimization.

Throughout my career, I’ve worked across the full technical spectrum, from database administration to advanced software engineering, cloud computing and game development, building a deep understanding of systems architecture and performance-critical applications. 

As an emulation and porting specialist, I focus on bringing complex software and game experiences across platforms while preserving performance, stability, and technical integrity. 

I have extensive experience profiling, optimizing, and fine-tuning projects to achieve scalable performance across diverse hardware targets.I’m also an indie game developer and a mentor for independent teams, guiding them through the gaming industry pipeline... from early concept and prototyping to production, optimization, and publishing. 

I help teams translate creative vision into technically solid, market-ready products.I strongly believe games are powerful learning tools. 

Complex subjects become intuitive when experienced interactively... even traditionally challenging topics like trigonometry can become engaging when seen through gameplay mechanics. 

As a lifelong gaming enthusiast, I combine technical depth with a detailed understanding of the gaming industry.In addition to engineering and mentorship, 

I have taught numerous courses on software engineering, SDLC, testing methodologies, algorithms, and data structures, and I’ve delivered talks internationally on these subjects. I enjoy bridging the gap between theory, production realities, and high-performance implementation.
